evidence:
Row-6 assessment only: no unreachable capability or materially competing interpretation found. The workbook Quality Checks!D7 permits public internet; the older Internal Quality Checks!D7 no-network wording is superseded by the actual quality row and skill delivery profile. The supplied environment installs Node 22, Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 and stages both notes and seed (task/environment/Dockerfile:1-16). The public brief names the launch, health, storage, asset-copy and no-additional-server-package contract (instruction.md:9-11); the frozen template provides the same server runtime. All seven accounts, three referring employees, fixed reference moment and required financial constants are supplied. No third-party account, absent backend, unavailable package or private input is needed. Node BigInt and SQLite transactions are sufficient for exact arithmetic and atomic writes; the implementation excerpts at solution/app/src/rules.js:54-69 and src/change-sets.js:80-98 substantiate feasibility without treating reference-specific routes as requirements.

The public rules settle the likely alternative readings explicitly: ordinary revision roles differ from initial offer creation (hireops_rules.md:36-45); optional operational demonstration history is stated twice (instruction.md:11 and rules:91-95); composition, band edges and exact rounding are defined (rules:79-87,111-145,154-172); UTC anniversaries preserve milliseconds and clamp from the original date (rules:292-305); referrals use the fixed reference moment while rescissions use the supplied effective date (rules:59-67,344-349). The coordinated contract defines 2-4 current members, actor-scoped immutable keys, order-independent intent, final-net headroom, touched-requisition history freshness, all-or-none settlement, authorization before cached writes, and immutable replay after later changes/restart (rules:423-480). These are implementable together. The specific optional requisition-intake allowance at rules:38-39 is an explicit exception for other roles, not a requirement to give the Auditor financial settlement rights.

Counterexample reasoning: a sequential-transfer implementation might look correct for ordinary affordable moves but refuses a fully funded exchange. That reading is expressly excluded by instruction.md:1 and rules:443-447; functional protocol B1 (prompt.md:55) observes it. The current local sequential_budget witness actually returns409 where the netted cycle expects200. A balance-only freshness implementation is likewise excluded by instruction.md:3 and rules:450-456; the current witness accepted200 where ABA freshness requires409. Conversely, a conforming implementation that starts with no operational seed history, generates its own record IDs, and chooses different endpoints remains permitted (instruction.md:11; rules:53-55,203-204,434-435). Functional prompt.md:13,23,49,53 expressly accommodates those choices; the empty_operational_seed witness completes all 15 local batch groups. These are finite scripted observations, not configured scores.

Current evidence was hash-checked: all 79 entries in raw-evidence-index.json matched their listed SHA256 at review time. Frozen source bindings also matched: batch-domain 4 files, batch-ui 14, domain 37, legacy-ui 13 and install-lifecycle 13. batch-domain/results.json SHA256 0c7f4da8fdc1037091fda6b28f5f2211f0ab1dfef0e1d7f2fb03c53c617d8af1 records 15 successful groups including netted cycles, stale ABA refusal, concurrent retry, immutable later replay and restart. Its actual driver assertions were read at local/batch-domain.cjs:35-119. batch-ui/results.json SHA256 c58daecb432c2bde6e4b005c42e85662c3a7b4810f1aa828f6ba69708656a6e5 records the labelled editor, preview/UI commit, stale-editor retention, actual committed response suppression/retry and independent Auditor readback; driver assertions are local/batch-ui.cjs:25-55. The legacy UI results additionally observe exact large-cent inputs and retained rescission dates. install-lifecycle/results.json records real sanitized unprivileged launch and process replacement retaining saved data.

This Pass establishes instruction feasibility and clarity for row 6. Local HTTP/browser scripts are not full configured judging, private deterministic checker execution, measured full-judge workload, Oracle/target-model scoring, reward ordering or portal acceptance; none is claimed or waived here. Those broader runtime evidence requirements retain their separate owners.
